title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
description: Add error handling throughout all tools and functions. All tools must catch and handle errors, error messages must be human-readable, errors must not crash the MCP server, error context must be preserved for debugging, and different error types must be categorized.
details: Sprint 4 - Error Handling & Developer Experience. Ensures robust error handling across all components.
testStrategy: Test error scenarios in all tools, verify server stability, check error message quality, verify error categorization.
